title: How do they compare? 比一比
description: Lesson 112 is a picture lesson about 'as...as' and 'not as...as' comparisons. Eighteen pictures (a-r) show pairs of things compared using as...as (sweet, tall, short, old, blunt, sharp) and not as...as (clean, fat, smart, light, new, expensive), followed by examples of difficult/more difficult/most difficult and interesting/less interesting/least interesting. The written exercises and grammar workbook section focus on age, weight and height comparisons using as...as and not as...as.
answer_note: Listening and written exercises A-C are model answers (suggested). Workbook A and B are from the workbook answer key (source-key). Grammar I-III are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, p.545).

lesson.text: This is the most difficult test I have ever done!
This is the least interesting book I have ever read!

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Listen to the recording and answer the questions for each picture (a-r).
lesson.translation: 听录音并回答每组图片（a-r）的问题。
lesson.context: The recording reads comparisons for each picture pair.

questions.prompt: Picture a: Compare the two apples (sweet).
questions.answer: The red apple is as sweet as the green apple.

questions.prompt: Picture b: Compare the two people (tall).
questions.answer: The policeman is as tall as the policewoman.

questions.prompt: Picture c: Compare the two people (short).
questions.answer: The man is as short as the woman.

questions.prompt: Picture d: Compare the two people (old).
questions.answer: The boy is as old as the girl.

questions.prompt: Picture e: Compare the two pencils (blunt).
questions.answer: The red pencil is as blunt as the green pencil.

questions.prompt: Picture f: Compare the two knives (sharp).
questions.answer: The red knife is as sharp as the green knife.

questions.prompt: Picture g: Compare the two cars (clean).
questions.answer: The blue car is not as clean as the red car.

questions.prompt: Picture h: Compare the two people (fat).
questions.answer: The woman is not as fat as the man.

questions.prompt: Picture i: Compare the two people (smart).
questions.answer: The boy is not as smart as the girl.

questions.prompt: Picture j: Compare the two boxes (light).
questions.answer: The red box is not as light as the blue box.

questions.prompt: Picture k: Compare the two bags (new).
questions.answer: The red bag is not as new as the blue bag.

questions.prompt: Picture l: Compare the two shops (expensive).
questions.answer: The red shop is not as expensive as the blue shop.

questions.prompt: Picture m: What do you think of this test?
questions.answer: This test is difficult.

questions.prompt: Picture n: What do you think of this test?
questions.answer: This test is more difficult.

questions.prompt: Picture o: What do you think of this test?
questions.answer: This is the most difficult test I have ever done!

questions.prompt: Picture p: What do you think of this book?
questions.answer: This book is interesting.

questions.prompt: Picture q: What do you think of this book?
questions.answer: This book is less interesting.

questions.prompt: Picture r: What do you think of this book?
questions.answer: This is the least interesting book I have ever read!

practice.title: Written exercise A
practice.instruction: Complete these sentences. (Two examples are given.)
practice.translation: 模仿例句完成以下句子。（已给出两个例子。）

questions.prompt: This book is cheap, but that one is ...
questions.answer: This book is cheap, but that one is more expensive.

questions.prompt: This book is expensive, but that one is ...
questions.answer: This book is expensive, but that one is cheaper.

questions.prompt: This question is easy, but that one is ...
questions.answer: This question is easy, but that one is more difficult.

questions.prompt: This question is difficult, but that one is ...
questions.answer: This question is difficult, but that one is easier.

practice.title: Written exercise B
practice.instruction: Write questions and answers. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 模仿例句提问并回答。（已给出一个例子。）
practice.context: Model questions and answers using as...as.

questions.prompt: policeman / tall / policewoman
questions.answer: Is the policeman as tall as the policewoman? No, he isn't. The policeman isn't as tall as the policewoman.

questions.prompt: man / short / woman
questions.answer: Is the man as short as the woman? Yes, he is. The man is as short as the woman.

questions.prompt: boy / old / girl
questions.answer: Is the boy as old as the girl? No, he isn't. The boy isn't as old as the girl.

questions.prompt: red pencil / blunt / green pencil
questions.answer: Is the red pencil as blunt as the green pencil? Yes, it is. The red pencil is as blunt as the green pencil.

questions.prompt: blue car / clean / red car
questions.answer: Is the blue car as clean as the red car? No, it isn't. The blue car isn't as clean as the red car.

questions.prompt: woman / fat / man
questions.answer: Is the woman as fat as the man? No, she isn't. The woman isn't as fat as the man.

practice.title: Written exercise C
practice.instruction: Write new sentences. (Two examples are given.)
practice.translation: 模仿例句改写以下句子。（已给出两个例子。）

questions.prompt: My radio is less expensive than yours. (ever seen)
questions.answer: No, it isn't. It is more expensive. It's the most expensive radio I've ever seen.

questions.prompt: Tom is less intelligent than Bill. (person / ever met)
questions.answer: No, he isn't. He is more intelligent. He's the most intelligent person I've ever met.

questions.prompt: My book is less interesting than yours. (ever read)
questions.answer: No, it isn't. It is more interesting. It's the most interesting book I've ever read.

questions.prompt: This test is more difficult. (ever done)
questions.answer: Yes, it is. It is the most difficult test I've ever done.

practice.title: Practice A: Complete the dialogues
practice.instruction: Complete the dialogues using comparative and superlative forms. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 用比较级和最高级形式完成对话。（已给出一个例子。）
practice.context: Workbook L112 A: adjectives expensive/difficult with comparative/superlative forms.

questions.prompt: A: These shoes are uncomfortable. What are yours like? (any others / ever worn)
questions.answer: B: They're more uncomfortable than any others. I think they're the most uncomfortable shoes I've ever worn.

questions.prompt: A: This second race is exciting. What do you think? (first race / ever seen)
questions.answer: B: It's more exciting than the first race. I think it's the most exciting race I've ever seen.

questions.prompt: A: What did you think of the test? Was it difficult? (less difficult / others / ever had)
questions.answer: B: It was less difficult than the others. I think it was the least difficult test I've ever had.

questions.prompt: A: I think London's interesting. What do you think? (many other cities / been to)
questions.answer: B: It's more interesting than many other cities. I think it's the most interesting city I've ever been to.

practice.title: Practice B: Compare using (not) as...as
practice.instruction: Compare these sentences using (not) as...as. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 用 (not) as...as 比较以下句子。（已给出一个例子。）

questions.prompt: Tom's 1m 20cm tall. His sister Jane is 1m 20cm tall, too. And Bob is 1m 30cm.
questions.answer: Jane is as tall as her brother Tom, but she isn't as tall as Bob.

questions.prompt: The Maths test was difficult. The French test was difficult, too. The English test was the most difficult.
questions.answer: The French test was as difficult as the Maths test, but it wasn't as difficult as the English test.

questions.prompt: Penny is 10 years old. Gary is 10, too. Sandra is 12 years old.
questions.answer: Gary is as old as Penny, but he isn't as old as Sandra.

questions.prompt: The yellow apples are sweet. The green ones are sweet, too. The red ones are the sweetest.
questions.answer: The green apples are as sweet as the yellow ones, but they aren't as sweet as the red ones.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Answer questions about children's ages
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用表格里提供的学生年龄的信息回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用表格里提供的学生年龄的信息回答下列问题。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.545 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Ages: Mary 14, Marie 16, Carol 16, Sophie 17, William 12, Jill 16, Scott 16, Jim 17. Item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Which girls are as old as Marie?
questions.answer: Carol and Jill are as old as Marie.

questions.prompt: Which boys are not as old as Jim?
questions.answer: William and Scott are not as old as Jim.

questions.prompt: Which girl is not as old as Carol?
questions.answer: Mary is not as old as Carol.

questions.prompt: Which boy is not as old as Scott?
questions.answer: William is not as old as Scott.

questions.prompt: Which boy is not as old as Mary?
questions.answer: William is not as old as Mary.

questions.prompt: Which boy is as old as Jill?
questions.answer: Scott is as old as Jill.

questions.prompt: Which girls are not as old as Sophie?
questions.answer: Mary, Marie, Carol and Jill are not as old as Sophie.

questions.prompt: Which boy is as old as Sophie?
questions.answer: Jim is as old as Sophie.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Finish sentences about children's weight
grammar.instruction: 用表格里提供的学生体重的信息完成下列各句。
grammar.translation: 用表格里提供的学生体重的信息完成下列各句。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.545 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Weights: Mary 45, Marie 55, Carol 47, Sophie 40, William 45, Jill 47, Scott 55, Jim 57.

questions.prompt: Mary is as heavy as ...
questions.answer: William

questions.prompt: Carol is not as heavy as ...
questions.answer: Marie, Scott or Jim

questions.prompt: William is not ...
questions.answer: as heavy as Marie, Carol, Jill, Scott or Jim

questions.prompt: Jill is as ...
questions.answer: heavy as Carol

questions.prompt: Scott is not ...
questions.answer: as heavy as Jim

questions.prompt: Marie is not ...
questions.answer: as heavy as Jim

questions.prompt: Marie is as ...
questions.answer: heavy as Scott

questions.prompt: Mary is not ...
questions.answer: as heavy as Marie, Carol, Jill, Scott or Jim

questions.prompt: Sophie is not ...
questions.answer: as heavy as Mary, Marie, Carol, William, Jill, Scott or Jim

questions.prompt: Jill is not ...
questions.answer: as heavy as Marie, Scott or Jim

grammar.title: Grammar III: Make sentences about children's height
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用表格里提供的学生身高的信息造句。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用表格里提供的学生身高的信息造句。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.545 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Heights: Mary 1.63, Marie 1.68, Carol 1.63, Sophie 1.60, William 1.60, Jill 1.65, Scott 1.65, Jim 1.68. Items 1-2 are printed examples.

questions.prompt: Mary is ... (height 1.63)
questions.answer: as tall as Carol.

questions.prompt: Mary is ... (height 1.63)
questions.answer: not as tall as Marie.

questions.prompt: Marie is ... (height 1.68)
questions.answer: as tall as Jim.

questions.prompt: Carol is ... (height 1.63)
questions.answer: not as tall as Jim.

questions.prompt: Sophie is ... (height 1.60)
questions.answer: as tall as William.

questions.prompt: William is ... (height 1.60)
questions.answer: not as tall as Mary.

questions.prompt: Jill is ... (height 1.65)
questions.answer: not as tall as Jim.

questions.prompt: Scott is ... (height 1.65)
questions.answer: as tall as Jill.

questions.prompt: Jim is ... (height 1.68)
questions.answer: as tall as Marie.

questions.prompt: Scott is ... (height 1.65)
questions.answer: not as tall as Marie.
